item_name: Rothco Security Mesh Back Tactical Cap - Black
item_short_desc: Keep security guards cool and comfortable while on the job with our mesh back tactical cap featuring “Security” embroidery.
description: Keep security guards cool and comfortable while on the job with our mesh back tactical cap featuring “Security” embroidery displayed on the front center of baseball style mesh hat.  Built with a lightweight, ultra-soft 4 panel mesh back with two reinforced ventilation holes to keep you cool and comfortable.  The solid front panel features a soft cotton material.  One size fits most with adjustable hook and loop strap closure.  This tactical cap is a great uniform accessory for security guards and public safety personnel.
